name: Acute myeloid leukemia with abnormal bone marrow eosinophils inv(16)(p13q22) or t(16;16)(p13;q22)
aliases: Acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues

criteria.description: Presence of inv(16)(p13q22) or t(16;16)(p13;q22) chromosomal abnormality detected by cytogenetic or molecular methods
Abnormal increase in bone marrow eosinophils with dysplastic features
Bone marrow or peripheral blood blasts ≥20%
Myeloid immunophenotype with expression of markers such as CD13, CD33, CD34, and aberrant expression of CD2 or CD7

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Detection of inv(16)(p13q22) or t(16;16)(p13;q22) chromosomal abnormality plus ≥20% blasts in bone marrow or peripheral blood with abnormal bone marrow eosinophilia
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of cytogenetic, morphologic, and immunophenotypic findings.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Abnormal bone marrow eosinophilia with dysplastic morphology
pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic abnormal eosinophils in bone marrow aspirate
searchTerms: dysplastic eosinophil cells in bone marrow

pathognomonic.symptomName: Presence of inv(16)(p13q22) or t(16;16)(p13;q22) chromosomal rearrangement

searchTerms: pale skin and tiredness from anemia
fatigue and pallor due to low red blood cells

common.symptomName: Thrombocytopenia resulting in petechiae or easy bruising
searchTerms: low platelets causing bruises and spots
recurrent infections due to immune weakness
infections caused by low white blood cells

common.notes: Enlargement of liver and spleen due to leukemic infiltration

common.symptomName: Bone pain due to marrow expansion

searchTerms: losing weight and sweating at night

occasional.notes: Enlarged lymph nodes due to leukemic infiltration

searchTerms: difficulty breathing from blood cell buildup
shortness of breath from thick blood

rare.symptomName: Central nervous system involvement with neurological deficits
searchTerms: nerve deficits due to CNS involvement

rare.symptomName: Renal impairment due to leukemic infiltration or tumor lysis syndrome
searchTerms: renal failure due to tumor or cell infiltration
kidney damage from cancer or treatment

laboratory: Peripheral blood smear showing myeloblasts and abnormal eosinophils
Bone marrow biopsy with ≥20% blasts and abnormal eosinophils
Cytopenias including anemia, thrombocytopenia, and neutropenia
imaging: Chest X-ray may show leukostasis-related infiltrates
other: Immunophenotyping showing myeloid markers CD13, CD33, CD34
Coagulation studies may reveal abnormalities in severe cases

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of inv(16) or t(16;16) chromosomal abnormalities
Different genetic mutations and fusion genes
Lack of inv(16) or t(16;16) rearrangements

redFlags: Signs of leukostasis such as respiratory distress or neurological symptoms
references: Arber DA, et al. The 2016 revision to the World Health Organization classification of myeloid neoplasms and acute leukemia. Blood. 2016.
Swerdlow SH, et al. WHO Classification of Tumours of Haematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues. IARC; 2017.
